text: All the time. Even when they cry.
My name is Leo. I'm sixteen. We moved here on Monday.
The neighbors came to say hello. They stood very, very close.
At the harbor, everyone waved at me. At exactly the same time.
The fisherman on the pier turned his head... all the way around.
I told Mom. Mom just smiled.
At midnight, every door in town opened.
Everyone walked outside. In their pajamas. In perfect rows.
And then they all looked up. At my window.
I didn't move. I pretended to sleep.
Then I heard it. Tap. Tap. Tap.
Their faces were pressed against my window.
